transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

I guess… I’m here because I can’t get past this feeling that I’m being punished. Like I let my father decline, and something has already been decided about me. My sister keeps showing me notes from the doctor, saying I did everything I could, but… it doesn’t really change it.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or guilty most days for the past two weeks?
Yes… most days. I wake up and it’s just this heavy, hollow feeling. Like everything’s gone dull. I can be at my desk at work, or looking out at the garden, and it just… doesn’t reach me anymore.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with loved ones?
I… I don’t know. I haven’t really kept track of it that way. Things just feel… less important, I guess.
Can you think back to the last few weeks — have you noticed that activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with family, feel less meaningful or interesting to you now?
I’m not really sure. I mean… things feel flat, but I haven’t been paying close attention to whether I enjoy them or not. I mostly just get through the day.
Looking back, have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with family, don’t interest you as much anymore?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been… checking it like that. Things feel kind of muted, I guess, but I can’t say for sure it’s that I’m not interested.
Looking back, have you found that you don’t care about things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, activities, or even time with people you love?
I… I can’t really tell. I haven’t thought about it that clearly. I guess I just sort of do what I have to do, and I don’t pay much attention to whether I care or not.
Looking back, have you found that you don’t care about things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, activities, or even time with people you love?
I don’t really know how to answer that. I haven’t… noticed it in a clear way. I’m mostly just trying to get through things, I guess.
Looking back, have you noticed that activities or hobbies you used to enjoy don’t seem to interest you anymore?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been paying attention to hobbies or anything like that… things just feel kind of there, I guess.
Looking back, can you recall if you still took pleasure in things you usually enjoy, like favorite activities or time with people you care about?
I… honestly don’t really know. I haven’t been thinking about it that way. Things happen, I’m there, but I can’t say if I’m taking pleasure in them or not.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in things you used to care about, like hobbies, activities, or even spending time with people you love?
I don’t know if I’d say completely. I haven’t really sorted it out like that. I just… haven’t been paying much attention to what I care about, I guess.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve had trouble feeling pleasure, even during activities or moments you usually enjoy, like a favorite hobby or time with someone close to you?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’m there for things, but I don’t know if I’d call it pleasure or not. I haven’t been thinking about it that clearly.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve completely stopped caring about things you used to care about, like hobbies, activities, or time with people you love?
I don’t know… “completely” feels like a lot. I guess I haven’t really been checking whether I care or not. Things just feel kind of… distant, maybe.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve lost interest or stopped feeling pleasure in almost all activities, even those you used to really enjoy?
I’m not sure I’d put it that strongly. I know things don’t feel the same, but… I haven’t really been keeping track of whether it’s almost everything.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve lost interest or felt no pleasure in almost all activities, even those you used to really enjoy?
I… I don’t really know. Things feel kind of flat, I guess, but I can’t say for sure it’s almost everything or that there’s no pleasure at all.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve lost interest in most activities, even ones you used to really enjoy?
I don’t know… maybe some, but I’m not sure I’d say most. I haven’t really thought about it that clearly.
Looking back, can you think of any specific activity or hobby that you used to really enjoy, but now you don’t seem to care about it anymore?
I can’t really think of one specific thing. I mean… I know I haven’t been as into things lately, but nothing comes to mind that I’d say I just don’t care about anymore.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve lost interest in most activities, even ones you used to really enjoy?
I’m still not sure. I know I’m less interested in things lately, but saying “most activities” feels… I don’t know, too definite.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, even things that were important or meaningful to you?
I… I don’t really know. I guess some things feel less appealing, but I can’t say clearly that I’ve lost interest in things that mattered to me. It’s hard to sort out.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve lost interest in most activities, even ones you used to really enjoy?
I don’t know… I know I’ve said that already, but I really can’t tell. Things feel kind of muted, I guess, but I’m not sure I’d say I’ve lost interest in most things.
Looking back, would you say that you’ve lost interest or felt no pleasure in almost all activities, even those you used to really enjoy?
I’m not sure I’d put it that strongly. Some things don’t feel the same, but… “almost all” and “no pleasure” feels hard for me to say.
